title: 2013 Prairie, the Reid house, takes its portico and balustrade
items: 2013 Prairie, William H. Reid's house of 1894, now stands as the Inland Architect pictured it a winter later: a narrow pale-brick front over a stone basement, an Ionic portico at its north end carrying a balustraded balcony, two tall capped windows beside it, three-light windows on the floors above under a round-arched light, and a heavy cornice with a balustrade along the roof. The two oval windows and the carved frame round the upper windows come next.
